sources.notes: Owner-approved research_index cache used for exhaustive discovery because it already contains the configured PubMed query metadata. Windows 2026-10-18 (Oct 18-24; 123 deduplicated candidates across configured searches) and 2026-10-25 (Oct 25-26; 29 candidates) were read in full in pages of at most 100; target dates were filtered only after primary date checks. Cache metadata was discovery only, not clinical evidence.

Same owner-approved complete research_index windows and configured major-journal query were reviewed. Final cross-check independently searched NEJM/JAMA/Lancet/BMJ acute-care publications; two Oct 23 NEJM thrombectomy RCTs were verified and included.

Same owner-approved complete research_index windows and configured specialty query were reviewed. Primary appraisal verified ICare-FASTER (Oct 19) and pediatric intubation-associated cardiac arrest (Oct 23). Other candidate results were either lower priority, outside the first-online interval, or retained for primary review.

Configured guidance discovery metadata in both complete research_index windows was reviewed separately from the society sweep. The crush consensus and POC hs-troponin meta-analysis had earlier first-online dates despite Oct 21 PubMed issue/index dates and were excluded.

Exact bounded search: site:journalfeed.org October 19 2026 October 25 2026 emergency medicine. Search indexing exposed stale/older pages rather than a verifiable complete interval, so JournalFeed coverage could not be certified; it was not used as evidence.

Exact bounded search: site:acep.org clinical policy October 2026 emergency medicine. Official clinical-policy directory showed no newly issued acute clinical policy first online Oct 19-25; search is bounded by public indexing.

Exact bounded search: site:professional.heart.org October 19 2026 October 25 2026 scientific statement emergency stroke resuscitation. Official recent-guidance pages showed Oct 22 aortic-surgery multidisciplinary guidance but no new acute stroke/resuscitation guideline in the interval; the aortic statement does not change ED acute management.

Exact bounded search: site:acc.org October 19 2026 October 25 2026 guideline acute emergency. Official guideline directory did not identify a new interval-specific acute ED guideline; existing 2026 PE and other guidance predated this week.

Exact bounded search: site:publications.aap.org/pediatrics October 19 2026 policy statement. COVID-19 vaccine policy displays an Oct 19 issue date but official article history shows Prepublication Release September 2, 2026, so it is ineligible by first-online date.

Bounded official-domain search of ACS trauma best-practice/guideline material found no date-verified new acute ED guidance first online Oct 19-25. Public indexing/access is incomplete, disclosed here.

Exact bounded search: site:ena.org October 2026 practice resources emergency guidance. Official practice-resource directory was reviewed; no date-verified new acute clinical guidance first online Oct 19-25 was found.
Bounded official-domain search of SAEM/GRACE material found no new acute-care guideline first online Oct 19-25; recent indexed society material was educational or predated the interval.
Exact bounded search: site:aaem.org statements October 2026 emergency medicine. Oct 21-22 statements concerned residency requirements and medical-staff due process, not acute clinical management.

Exact bounded search: site:hematology.org guidelines October 2026 bleeding anticoagulation emergency. Official guideline directory showed no new interval-specific emergency bleeding/anticoagulation guidance.

Exact bounded search: site:chestnet.org October 19 2026 October 25 2026 guideline pulmonary embolism. No new acute-care CHEST guideline first online in the interval was identified; the multisociety acute PE guideline predates this week.

Exact bounded search: site:sccm.org October 19 2026 October 25 2026 guideline sepsis. Official directory showed the 2026 Surviving Sepsis Campaign guidance, released months earlier, and no new interval-specific sepsis guideline.

Exact bounded search: site:idsociety.org practice guideline October 2026 emergency acute. Official status/list pages showed no new acute IDSA guideline first online Oct 19-25; relevant 2026 sepsis/COVID/histoplasmosis updates predated the interval.

Exact bounded search: site:acmt.net October 19 2026 October 25 2026 statement toxicology. Official statement/archive pages showed conference activity in the interval but no new position/practice statement first online during it.

Exact bounded search: site:east.org practice management guideline October 2026 trauma. Official PMG directory and under-development pages were checked; no date-verified new acute trauma PMG first online Oct 19-25 was identified.
Exact bounded search: site:eso-stroke.org guidelines October 2026 stroke. Official indexed guideline material showed no new hyperacute stroke guideline first online Oct 19-25.
Exact bounded search: site:acog.org clinical October 2026 emergency obstetric guideline. Official clinical guidance search did not identify a new obstetric-emergency guideline first online Oct 19-25.

Exact bounded search: site:erc.edu guidelines October 2026 resuscitation. Official ERC pages continue to identify the 2025 resuscitation guidelines as current; no new Oct 19-25 resuscitation guideline was found.

finalCrossCheck: Major emergency-medicine RCT cross-check: all 152 cached discovery candidates across the two approved overlapping windows were enumerated; no additional large ED RCT comparable in consequence to the included stroke trials was verified.
NEJM acute-care cross-check: Oct 23 online-first LATE-MT and MILD-MT were verified against primary journal/PubMed records and included.
JAMA acute-care cross-check: bounded interval search found no additional major acute-care RCT judged more consequential than the included records.
Lancet acute-care cross-check: bounded interval search found no major ED-changing acute-care trial first online Oct 19-25.
BMJ acute-care cross-check: bounded interval search found no major ED-changing randomized acute-care trial first online Oct 19-25.
ACEP clinical-policy cross-check: no new acute clinical policy first online Oct 19-25 was identified on the official clinical-policy directory.
AHA/ASA cross-check: no new acute stroke or resuscitation guideline first online Oct 19-25; Oct 22 aortic-surgery statement was not an ED acute-management guideline.
SCCM/sepsis cross-check: 2026 Surviving Sepsis Campaign guidance predates this interval; no new interval-specific sepsis guidance was found.
IDSA cross-check: no new acute ID guideline first online Oct 19-25 was identified on official current-guideline pages.
CHEST/PE cross-check: no new interval-specific acute PE guideline; the 2026 multisociety acute PE guideline predates this week.
Hematology/bleeding cross-check: no new ASH emergency bleeding or anticoagulation guideline first online Oct 19-25 was identified.
Toxicology cross-check: ACMT statement pages showed no new practice/position statement first online Oct 19-25; conference activity alone was not treated as guidance.
Trauma cross-check: EAST official PMG pages showed no new date-verified acute trauma guideline first online Oct 19-25.

Pediatric emergency cross-check: AAP COVID policy carried an Oct 19 issue date but a Sept 2 prepublication release and was excluded by first-online date; pediatric ventilation feedback and intubation-arrest studies were appraised separately.
Obstetric emergency cross-check: ACOG official guidance search found no new acute obstetric emergency guideline first online Oct 19-25.
First-online trap cross-check: PMID 42481217 and PMID 42660638 were excluded because primary/official pages place them months earlier than Oct 19 despite later issue/index dates.

excludedCandidates.reason: POC hs-troponin meta-analysis was first published online months before Oct 19; Oct 21 reflects later issue/index metadata and is ineligible.
Crush injury consensus was first available in August 2026, before the target week; later Oct issue/index date cannot move it into this brief.
Official article history shows prepublication release September 2, 2026; Oct 19 is not the first-online date.
Randomized crossover pediatric ventilation-feedback simulation showed large process improvements but no patient outcomes; lower priority than the fifth record allowed by today's cap.
VECARS-2 primary abstract was verified; observational before-after process evidence without patient outcome benefit. Deferred by the daily five-record cap and retained in queue.
Date and identifiers verified, but accessible primary metadata did not expose sufficient results for an evidence-grade summary in this run; retained for primary review.

Date and identifiers verified; detailed numerical results were not available from an accessible primary abstract in this run, so secondary-only result detail was not promoted to a stored article; retained for primary review.
Systematic review/meta-analysis was date-eligible but accessible primary metadata did not provide enough result detail, and the question was lower priority than selected evidence; not used as filler.
First online September 29, 2026; explicitly outside Oct 19-25.
